output.market_context: This quarter's tracked filings cluster in semiconductors, power and mega-cap compounders, with most names showing fresh single-quarter builds rather than multi-quarter accumulation. Insider confirmation is uneven: several leaders pair institutional buying with open-market purchases, while the largest-cap names show only sales.
